title: Strong SOC Analyst JD
job_description: We are seeking a SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations team. The analyst will monitor security events, investigate alerts, and support incident response activities to protect client environments. Responsibilities include monitoring SIEM alerts, investigating suspicious authentication and network activity, documenting incidents in the ticketing system, escalating confirmed incidents according to established procedures, and contributing to threat-hunting activities. Required qualifications include a bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field, 1-2 years of experience in a SOC or security monitoring role, understanding of TCP/IP and common attack techniques, and hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel. Familiarity with EDR platforms and scripting with Python or PowerShell is preferred. The role is hybrid and reports to the SOC Manager.
